known_limitations: run_id was not recorded at measurement time, so these records carry no run identity. That is stated rather than backfilled -- inventing one would be fabricating provenance.
preregistration_digest is absent because no preregistration existed.

config_id in these records was computed by a version of MeasurementConfig that included served_model_version, so the report-level configuration list does NOT join back to these records. That defect is the reason the field was removed; it is not repaired retroactively here.

The audit packet in this directory was generated by the pre-repair sampler, which keyed on case_id and drew from a population that included outages. It is retained only as a record of what was produced, and must not be used to satisfy any coverage requirement.
not_combinable_with: evals/g1/formal/ (freeze v3), evals/g1/formal_freeze_v2/, evals/g1/formal_superseded_freeze_v1/ -- no preregistration existed when these were measured, so their statistics may never be pooled with any preregistered population
what_this_is: The G1 supervisor decisions measured BEFORE any preregistration commit existed. They are real measurements through the governed supervisor path and are preserved unmodified.
why_it_is_separate: No freeze existed when these were taken, so nothing proves the corpus, criteria or gold labels were fixed beforehand. Their statistics must never be pooled with the preregistered run: the unfrozen half would borrow the frozen half's authority. Any future aggregation must be a versioned artifact that names both populations explicitly.
